verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Turso serves an llms.txt index at docs.turso.tech/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that links to Markdown versions of its docs pages. A second probe shows each .md page tells agents to fetch the full documentation index from llms.txt, and agent-oriented guides such as agent-databases.md and ai-memory.md are also served as Markdown. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other consolidated full-text bundle.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.turso.tech/llms.txt # Turso
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.turso.tech/llms.txt
AI agents need databases to store context, track state, and maintain memory across executions.
